The stunning landscapes of Norway provided inspiration for the world ofFrozen. From snow-capped mountains to shimmering fjords, Norway is a real-life winter wonderland that feels straight out of a fairy tale. Wander through charming villages with colourful wooden houses, stroll along snow-dusted streets, or cruise through majestic fjords. In winter, the country transforms into a magical land of ice and snow, perfect for skiing, dog sledding, or chasing the northern lights.

Click HERE to plan your Norwegian adventure and create your own winter story.

The tale of Frozen was originally inspired by Danish author Hans Christian Andersen’s The Snow Queen. In winter, Copenhagen becomes a true wonderland, with numerous indoor and outdoor ice rinks. Tivoli Gardens, the historic amusement park, features a large ice skating rink alongside festive seasonal activities, making it the perfect place to step into a storybook scene.

Click HERE to add a magical Copenhagen experience to your itinerary.

Bring the magic of Frozen to life across Disney Parks around the world. From Meet & Greets with Anna, Elsa, Kristoff, Olaf, and even the Trolls to captivating stage shows and interactive experiences, every park offers a taste of Arendelle. At Hong Kong Disneyland, you can explore the immersive World of Frozen, while Disney Adventure World in Paris is set to open its own version in March 2026. EPCOT at Walt Disney World and Hong Kong Disneyland feature the beloved Frozen Ever After ride, and soon Paris will join them. Meanwhile, Tokyo DisneySea offers Anna & Elsa’s Frozen Journey in the all-new Fantasy Springs, transporting you straight into the story.
